item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 19/Aug/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A broad trough of low pressure will continue to bring showers and squally thunderstorms to the coast of southern China and the northern part of the South China Sea in the next couple of days. Showers will be heavy at times. With an anticyclone aloft strengthening, the weather will improve and it will be very hot over Guangdong in the latter part of this week and early next week. Meanwhile, winds will be weak over the region. High temperatures may also trigger showers. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Jongdari near the Ryukyu Islands will move across the East China Sea to Yellow Sea in the next couple of days.
